label: Ferrochrome studio style LoRA
notes: Photoreal android/cyborg material language — carbon fibre, chrome, neon, cinematic-real (NOT product-render photoreal). Three registers (outcast / cyclops / welded) plus contact and material-macro lanes, ONE LoRA. Captions are content-only prose, trigger-first ('ferrochrome, a <subject>, <scene>') — style vocabulary belongs to the trigger, never the caption. A machine captioner WILL emit style vocabulary; the strip pass is mandatory. eligible_lanes deliberately empty (lane-mismatch gotcha drops all rows otherwise). Hyperparameters are the SAME PINNED RECIPE as rustline-style-lora and tallow_fen_style_v3 — single lever is the dataset. Do not tune hyperparameters and dataset in the same wave.
_venue: LOCAL (5090). Comfy Cloud has no LoRA weight-export path — SaveLoRA / LoraSave / SaveLoraNode all absent from the catalog, verified 2026-08-22, and confirmed independently by Comfy consult #4 Q2. A Cloud training run bills GPU time and leaves nothing behind.
_calibration_rule: First training run is a SHORT calibration run (a few hundred steps), not the full 2000. It measures per-step burn and confirms the loss curve descends before the budget is committed. Adopted from Comfy consult #4.
